Please be advised that we wanted to send over update with regards to the standard subject lines. Good day All

Please be advised that we wanted to send over update with regards to the standard subject lines.  Due to the Crew Planning team implementing their general inboxes, we have updated our subject line requests to include the Rank.  This allows for the proper routing for the Crew Planning teams general inboxes, as well as the crew travel teams inboxes.

We are now upon the high-volume season, with the holidays coming soon and we are seeing quite an influx of emails being sent in for many requests to be processed, without using the proper subject lines.  This will only delay our response as they may not get routed properly.  

I appreciate the urgency of needing the flights quickly when they are submitted into MAPS, we do our best to get the flights updated within 24 to 48 hours.  Keep this in mind before sending an email, as you may see the flights updated in MAPS, you can save yourself as well as the crew travel teams time by fielding an extra email.

Thank you very much for your assistance with this very important matter.

As always, if you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to me directly.

Regards
Nichole

		Good day Crew Care Team, 

		 

		I am writing in reference to the report key: 718044272301: regarding my unfair dismissal on July 22nd just shy of my sign-off date which was due to be August 16th.

		 

		The sequence of the events which led up to me getting an SD 6 and my subsequent discharge from the ship had started with me getting an SD1 (a written warning) for such a minor indiscretion not too long into my contract. This affected my confidence and self-esteem - especially because it was issued to me by my supervisor (Lauren Louise Lee) who I had been working with for 2 consecutive contracts. Since the first contract I worked with her on the Venture last year - she has been someone who tries to assert her authority through direct and indirect micro-aggressive racial stereotypical actions and statements. Since I was observant of that behaviour in her - she made it a point to victimize me in subtle ways; by always finding ways to criticise my work despite my best efforts.

		 

		Thereafter, there was an honest mistake I made which warranted a warning but again the Hotel Director - Nic Botha-Simpson issued me an SD4 - which I considered harsh but I accepted it as it was my own mistake.

		 

		Following up to this I made another minor transgression which led to me being issued an SD6. Chief Purser (Jo Marie van Biljon) made it a point to exaggerate the issue and prompted HRM Barry to summon a Masters hearing for me.

		 

		Throughout all these events I was subtly victimized, told that I was being put on a PIP (Performance Improvement Plan) which caused me emotional distress and subsequently affected my work performance as I was made to feel like an incompetent team member.

		 

		No one in the so-called management would take notice of all the other areas that I thrived in - I had frequent positive guest recognition and feedback; but when mistakes happened - that was highlighted as if all my other best efforts meant nothing.

		 

		As I type up this email, I am back home in South Africa - jobless and stressed out for my family and I. It took me time to muster up the courage to even send this email as I have been processing this whole situation. 

		 

		I know that I made my mistakes but an equally mean-spirited management (mainly comprising of Caucasian South Africans - notorious for racism) created a toxic working environment that affected not only myself  but other crew members. Perhaps their cases were not as extreme that is why there may be no mention of them.

		 

		The above-mentioned Officers lack empathy, compassion and rather invalidate team members despite their best efforts. They unfairly enforce policies as a way to assert their authority. My dismissal was a few days before the start of a new cruise which meant that the team ended up having a short staffed cruise for the Guest Services department.They were so eager to get rid of me like I was the worst thing -  they didn't  even consider how that would affect operations - that's how irrational they are.
